entities.summary: Bagratuni, a notable figure in the history of Armenia, associated with Medieval Armenian Kingdoms (885–1045). Preceded by Arab and Seljuk Domination of Eastern Armenia and Arab Caliphate. Their legacy influenced Ani becomes capital of the Bagratid Kingdom and flourishes as a major city and Seljuk Turks conquer Ani after the Battle of Manzikert.
